# dokploy_notifications (Data Source)

Fetches all notification configurations from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover notification IDs.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_notifications" "all" {}

# Output all notification IDs
output "notification_ids" {
  value = { for n in data.dokploy_notifications.all.notifications : n.name => n.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `notifications` (Attributes List) List of all notifications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifications))

<a id="nestedatt--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Read-Only:

- `app_build_error` (Boolean) Whether to notify on app build errors.
- `app_deploy` (Boolean) Whether to notify on app deployment.
- `database_backup` (Boolean) Whether to notify on database backup.
- `docker_cleanup` (Boolean) Whether to notify on Docker cleanup.
- `dokploy_restart` (Boolean) Whether to notify on Dokploy restart.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification.
- `name` (String) The name of the notification.
- `notification_type` (String) The type of notification (slack, discord, telegram, email).
